notes: Read SKILL.md and references/cfn-syntax.md in full. CloudFormation reference: template structure, stack create/update/delete, change sets, drift detection, nested stacks with aws cloudformation package/deploy, intrinsic functions, stack policies, and troubleshooting.

Following it can make the agent run AWS CLI commands that create, update, and delete stacks in the user's account with their configured credentials, and optionally pip install cfn-lint (SKILL.md:28). Medium because these change real cloud infrastructure; acceptable because the skill favors safe practices (change sets reviewed before execute-change-set at SKILL.md:204-227, termination protection, ROLLBACK on failure, a stack policy denying database replacement) and the delete example targets a dev stack (SKILL.md:198). Users should confirm before create/delete/execute steps.

The Related Skills section (SKILL.md:441-445) links to sibling skills (../terraform-aws/, ../aws-iam/, ../aws-vpc/, ../aws-ec2/, ../aws-s3/) that do not ship with this skill; they are optional pointers. AMI IDs, VPC/subnet IDs and S3 template URLs are placeholders. Frontmatter declares license: MIT.
